article.title: Lorikeet推出Dreamweaver，按客戶目標安排主動跟進
article.title_en: Lorikeet launches Dreamweaver for goal-based proactive customer follow-up
article.summary: Lorikeet公布Dreamweaver，以啟用、留存等目標安排語音、短訊及電郵聯繫。
article.summary_en: Lorikeet announced Dreamweaver for voice, SMS and email outreach around goals such as activation and retention.
highlights: 可按排程或使用情況變化跟進，也可建立團隊任務或不採取動作。
公司稱每則訊息均檢查聯絡時間、限制及同意設定。
highlights_en: It can respond to schedules or usage changes, create a team task, or take no action.
The company says messages are checked against contact hours, limits and consent.
article.why: CRM團隊可把跟進節奏與客戶目標連起來，並把聯絡規則納入自動化。
article.why_en: CRM teams can connect follow-up cadence to customer goals and build contact rules into automation.
article.next_step: 先選一個啟用目標，訂明同意、頻次及停止聯絡規則，再評估測試。
article.next_step_en: Define one activation goal, consent, frequency and stop-contact rules before evaluating a test.
article.detail: Dreamweaver建於Lorikeet的Concierge代理之上，會使用客戶歷史、回覆習慣及團隊註記決定跟進方式。官方稱功能已提供，企業可申請使用；這不代表任何現有帳戶都自動啟用。公告亦描述對照組量度及早期客戶成果，本報未核驗完整研究方法或產品表現，因此不沿用增長比例，亦不把主動聯繫寫成已證實提高客戶終身價值。
article.detail_en: Dreamweaver builds on Concierge agents and uses customer history, response preferences and staff notes. The vendor says access is available through sign-up, not automatically enabled in every account. Its early results are not independently validated here; no lifetime-value uplift is asserted.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
